the FT genes are expressed in the leaves of short day onion and the expression of the FT genes is associated with bulb formation.
the FT genes are expressed at different stages in the bulbing process.

the expression of FT genes in short day onion and their association with bulbing.
the identification of the FT genes in onion and the expression of these genes during the bulbing phase of onion.
